svg.title: Left: in the z-plane, the ellipse |z + mu z-bar| = 1 for mu = 0.4 e^{i pi/3}, with semi-minor axis 1/(1+|mu|) in the direction arg(mu)/2 and semi-major axis 1/(1-|mu|) perpendicular to it. Right: the unit circle in the h-plane, its image under h(z) = z + mu z-bar, with the two axis directions preserved.
